articles.zh: 阅读如何重塑你的大脑
body: Scientists have found that learning to read actually changes the structure of the brain, not just what we know.
科学家发现,学会阅读真的会改变大脑的结构,而不只是我们知道的东西。
Regular reading strengthens the connections between different areas, helping us focus and understand ideas more deeply.
经常阅读会加强大脑不同区域之间的连接,帮助我们更专注、更深入地理解想法。
Even ten minutes of reading a day, in any language, can slowly reshape how your mind works.
哪怕每天只读十分钟,用任何语言都行,都能慢慢重塑你大脑的运作方式。
Many cities are noisy places, and constant noise can quietly raise our stress without us noticing.
很多城市都很吵,而持续的噪音会在我们没察觉时悄悄升高压力。
Some towns are now adding more trees, quiet zones and softer road surfaces to lower the everyday noise.
一些城镇正通过多种树、设置安静区和更柔软的路面,来降低日常噪音。
Finding a quiet corner for a few minutes each day can help your ears and your mind rest.
每天找个安静的角落待上几分钟,能让你的耳朵和头脑得到休息。
Poetry is not only something we study at school; for many people it brings comfort in hard times.
诗歌不只是学校里学的东西;对很多人来说,它在艰难时刻带来慰藉。
A few short lines can express feelings that are hard to say in ordinary words.
短短几行就能表达那些用平常话很难说清的感受。
Reading or writing a small poem can be a gentle way to understand your own emotions.
读一首或写一首小诗,是理解自己情绪的一种温柔方式。

articles.en: Why Are We All So Stressed?
articles.zh: 为什么我们都这么焦虑
body: Modern life keeps us busy, and many people feel stressed almost every single day.
现代生活让我们忙个不停,很多人几乎每天都感到有压力。
Some stress can push us to act, but too much of it harms our sleep, mood and health.
适度的压力能推动我们行动,但压力太大会损害睡眠、情绪和健康。
Simple habits like slow breathing, a short walk or talking to a friend can ease the pressure.
一些简单的习惯,比如慢呼吸、走一小段路或找朋友聊聊,就能缓解压力。

articles.en: How Advertisers Make Us Spend Money
body: Advertisers use clever tricks to make us want things we did not plan to buy.
广告商用巧妙的手法,让我们想要那些本没打算买的东西。
Bright colours, limited-time offers and happy faces are all designed to push us to spend.
鲜艳的颜色、限时优惠和快乐的表情,都是为了推动我们消费而设计的。
Knowing these tricks helps us pause, think, and keep more of our own money.
了解这些手法能帮我们停一停、想一想,把更多钱留在自己手里。
